He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State Seminoles]]. ==Early life and high school career== Williams grew up in [[Charlotte, North Carolina]] and attended [[West Charlotte High School]]. He was a four-year starter on the Mighty Lions' varsity basketball team. Williams averaged 20.7 points, 7.7 rebounds, 3.7 assists and 2.8 steals in his junior season.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/louisville/Article/Louisville-has-offered-West-Charlotte-High-School-standout-Patrick-Williams-and-are-becoming-serious-with-the-four-star-prospect-117829554/|title=Louisville becoming 'serious' with Charlotte SF Patrick Williams|first=Jody|last=Demling|website=[[247Sports.com]]|date=April 28, 2019|access-date=December 20, 2019}} Williams was rated a four-star recruit and a consensus top-50 prospect in his class.{{cite web|url=https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/college/louisville/2018/07/17/louisville-basketball-among-patrick-williams-favorites/786435002/|title=Louisville basketball among the favorites for 4-star Patrick Williams|first=Fletcher|last=Page|work=[[The Courier-Journal]]|date=July 17, 2018|access-date=December 20, 2019}} Williams committed to play college basketball at Florida State over basketball|Maryland]], [[NC State Wolfpack men's basketball|NC State]], [[Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball|Ohio State]], [[Texas Longhorns men's basketball|Texas]], [[Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball|Virginia Tech]] and [[Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball|Wake Forest]].{{cite web|url=https://www.charlotteobserver.com/latest-news/article219606055.html|title=West Charlotte’s
